sources.snippet: g1-inspire-redball-n16-waist GR00T N1.6 fine-tune for the Unitree G1 + Inspire RH56DFTP red-ball pick-and-place task, with waist control — the successor to birbirll/g1-inspire-redball-n16 trained on the 33-D action layout (7+7 arms, 6+6 hands, 3 waist, nav (3) + base_height, waist actions derived from state with a +6-frame lead).

sources.title: GR00T N1.6 - research.nvidia.com
sources.snippet: Introduction We introduce GR00T N1.6, an improved version of the GR00T N1.5 foundation model for humanoid robots. With several architecture, data and modeling improvements, we find that N1.6 outperforms N1.5 on both simulated manipulation benchmarks and on real bimanual YAM, Agibot Genie-1 and Unitree G1 robots, detailed below.
